t: You're on Notting Hill Gate, one of the main thoroughfares of Kensington and Chelsea. The name comes from the toll gates that once stood on this street. Several notable people have connections here. The crime writer P. D. James lived on this street. Leonard of Mayfair, the celebrity hairdresser who is credited with creating the haircut that launched the model Twiggy, was born here. The boxer Young Joseph, a British welterweight champion, died here, as did the general Sir Frederick Smith of the Royal Engineers.
